remarks: This is the one! Welcome to 3 Mystic Lane, a home that exudes charm and many of the high-end updates you desire. Set privately at the end of a small cul-de-sac, the 2+ acre setting with footbridge over a tiny stream displays beautiful perennial gardens, flat yard for play, garden shed, deck, and pool with patio. Come inside and you will love the light and bright spaciousness in the public rooms. The oversized Living Room has a fireplace and opens to the Dining Room. The Family Room is cozy with another fireplace and French doors to the Sun Room with 1/2 bath and doors to the deck. The eat-in kitchen is renovated beautifully with high-end appliances and walk-in pantry. There are 3 Bedrooms on the main floor and 2 beautifully renovated full baths. One of the bedrooms has been converted to an office with bookshelves. Upstairs there are 2 additional bedrooms, a full bath, and large attic storage space. The basement is enormous boasting a cedar closet and unfinished space galore. This home won't disappoint! Look forward to seeing you!
